title: Notion → Hetzner Transport Repair
description:
## Mission Objective
Make Notion Pending → canonical GitHub mission → Agent execution operational without manual intervention. GitHub remains canonical. Do not start Phase 3.

## Required Implementation
Read each Pending Notion page body through the official Notion API; use database properties only for metadata.
Store the complete page body as mission.description.
Derive acceptanceCriteria only from an explicit Definition of Done or Acceptance Criteria heading. Reject ambiguous/malformed pages visibly; never create generic criteria.
Integrate Notion sync into every eligible polling cycle before canonical mission discovery. Do not run expensive verification while idle.
Add non-secret health evidence: last Notion sync, last successful transport, last materialized mission, last orchestrator cycle, last error.
Add a deployable canonical systemd installation/verification path. It must prove enabled/active/ExecStart/process/journal evidence, and target scripts/growth/agent-loop/index.ts poll.
Verify NOTION_TOKEN only as configured/not configured and Notion authorization/database access pass/fail. Never print the token.
Preserve Pending until the GitHub push succeeds; set Synced only after that success.
acceptanceCriteria: Current Inbox schema with only Mission, Mission ID, Priority, Source, Status is accepted.
Page body parsing produces complete description and criteria from an explicit heading.
Malformed page body is rejected without a GitHub mission or Notion Synced update.
Duplicate Notion item and duplicate canonical mission are safe and visible.
Missing NOTION_TOKEN, Notion API failure, and git push failure are surfaced with durable health evidence.
Pending becomes Synced only after a successful GitHub push.
Systemd worker runs integrated poll mode against the canonical implementation.
Existing mission-control-plane-review-integrity-v3 is ingested automatically after repair.
No deployment of the product, no self-review, and no Phase 3 start.
